139	    } else {
140	      const p = b as PrevOut;
141	      st.frameX[i] = p.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = p.fy[i];

149	// ---- 八通道 diff（_mile8 cmp 口径）----
150	interface Row { idx: number; tag: string; dA: number; dT: number; dW: number; dL: number; dHf: number; dSl: number; dLt: number; dIa: number; first: string; pairs: Array<[string, number]>; samples: string[] }
151	function diffStore(tag: string, idx: number, st: TileStore): Row {
152	  const c = chans(idx);
153	  const r: Row = { idx, tag, dA: 0, dT: 0, dW: 0, dL: 0, dHf: 0, dSl: 0, dLt: 0, dIa: 0, first: '', pairs: [], samples: [] };
154	  const pair = new Map<string, number>();
155	  let firstI = -1;
156	  const mark = (i: number) => { if (firstI < 0) firstI = i; };
157	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
158	    const va = c.a[i]!, ja = st.flags[i]! & 1;
159	    if (va !== ja) { r.dA++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`A(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${va} j${ja}`); }
160	    const vt = va ? c.t[i]! : 0;
161	    const jt = ja ? (SHEET[st.type[i]!] >= 0 ? SHEET[st.type[i]!]! : 9999) : 0;
162	    if (vt !== jt) { r.dT++; mark(i); const k = `T${vt}>${jt}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`T(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vt} j${jt}`); }
163	    if (c.w[i]! !== st.wall[i]!) { r.dW++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`W(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.w[i]} j${st.wall[i]}`); }
164	    if (c.l[i]! !== st.liquid[i]!) { r.dL++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`L(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.l[i]} j${st.liquid[i]}`); }
165	    if (c.hf[i]! !== st.half[i]!) { r.dHf++; mark(i); const k = `H${c.hf[i]}>${st.half[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`H(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.hf[i]} j${st.half[i]}`); }
166	    if (c.sl[i]! !== st.slope[i]!) { r.dSl++; mark(i); const k = `S${c.sl[i]}>${st.slope[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`S(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.sl[i]} j${st.slope[i]}`); }
167	    const vl = c.l[i]! > 0 ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
168	    const jl = st.liquid[i]! > 0 ? st.liquidType[i]! : 0;
169	    if (vl !== jl) { r.dLt++; mark(i); const k = `Y${vl}>${jl}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`Y(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vl} j${jl} liq${c.l[i]}`); }
170	    const via = c.ia[i]! ? 1 : 0;
171	    const jia = (st.wire[i]! >>> 5) & 1;
172	    if (via !== jia) { r.dIa++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`I(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${via} j${jia}`); }
173	  }
174	  if (firstI >= 0) r.first = `(${firstI % W},${Math.floor(firstI / W)})`;
175	  r.pairs = [...pair.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8).map(([k, n]) => [k, n] as [string, number]);
176	  return r;
177	}
178	const isClean = (r: Row) => !(r.dA || r.dT || r.dW || r.dL || r.dHf || r.dSl || r.dLt || r.dIa);
179	function printRow(r: Row): void {
180	  const bad = !isClean(r);
181	  console.log(`${String(r.idx).padStart(3)} ${DUMPNAME.get(r.idx)} ← ${r.tag.padEnd(28)} ` +
182	    `A=${String(r.dA).padStart(6)} T=${String(r.dT).padStart(6)} W=${String(r.dW).padStart(5)} L=${String(r.dL).padStart(5)} ` +
183	    `Hf=${String(r.dHf).padStart(5)} Sl=${String(r.dSl).padStart(5)} Lt=${String(r.dLt).padStart(4)} Ia=${String(r.dIa).padStart(4)} ${bad ? '✗ ' + r.first : '✓'}`);
184	  if (bad) {
185	    console.log(`     pairs: ${r.pairs.map(([k, n]) => `${k}×${n}`).join(' ')}`);
186	    console.log(`     samples: ${r.samples.join(' | ')}`);
187	  }
188	}

199	/** 跨槽生产者重算：shrineSpots / oceanTreasures（golden47/36 干净基座 + m_ 中途边界） */
200	function computeProducers(): { shrineSpots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>; oceanTreasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> } {
201	  const mj = boundary('m_JungleShrines');
202	  const { st: stJ } = buildHybrid(47, mj);
203	  restoreGenSolid(mj.gensolid);
204	  const shrineSpots = runJungleShrinePass(stJ, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mj.gs) as GenState);
205	  const mo = boundary('m_OceanCaves');
206	  const { st: stO } = buildHybrid(36, mo);
207	  restoreGenSolid(mo.gensolid);
208	  const oceanTreasures = runOceanCavesPass(stO, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mo.gs) as GenState);
209	  return { shrineSpots, oceanTreasures };
210	}

212	async function runSettleStep(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, rng: RNG, world: World): Promise<void> {
213	  world.store = st;
214	  world.shimmerX = gs.shimmerX; world.shimmerY = gs.shimmerY;
215	  world.genWaterLine = gs.waterLine;
216	  if ((gs.dungeonSide as number) === 0) world.genDungeonExempt = null;
217	  else {
218	    const edge = Math.floor(world.w * 0.05), mid = Math.floor(world.w * 0.55);
219	    world.genDungeonExempt = gs.dungeonSide < 0
220	      ? { x0: edge, x1: Math.floor(world.w * 0.45), y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 }
221	      : { x0: mid, x1: world.w - edge, y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 };
222	  }
223	  await settleWorldLiquids(world, 'gen', undefined, rng);
224	  flipGenSolid([484], false);
225	}

 *  超级飞镖陷阱(135,曾误用 137)并 WireLine 拉红线——L 形拐点=(陷阱x,雕像y)
 *  （cs:111-129：横段沿 start(雕像)y、竖段沿 end(陷阱)x）。 */
export function placeStatueTrap(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || x < 20 || x > st.w - 21 || y < 20 || y > st.h - 21 || !TRAP) return;
  for (let i = -10; i <= 10; i++) {
    for (let j = -10; j <= 10; j++) {
      const tx = x + i, ty = y + j;
      if (!st.inBounds(tx, ty + 1)) continue;
      const ci = st.idx(tx, ty), bi = st.idx(tx, ty + 1);
      if (st.flags[ci]) continue;                                   // !tile2.active()
      // SolidTile2(tile)（cs:70178）：active && 生成期 tileSolid && slope==0 && !halfBrick && !inActive
      if (!st.flags[bi] || st.half[bi] || st.slope[bi] !== 0 || ((st.wire[bi] >>> 5) & 1) === 1
        || !vanGenSolidType(st.type[bi])) continue;
      if (st.type[bi] === TRAP_162) continue;                       // tile.type != 162（冰特判）
      st.setTileSilent(tx, ty, TRAP, 0, 0);
      // WireLine(new Point(x,y), new Point(tx,ty))：横段沿雕像 y、竖段沿陷阱 x
      const x0 = Math.min(x, tx), x1 = Math.max(x, tx);
      const y0 = Math.min(y, ty), y1 = Math.max(y, ty);
      for (let wx = x0; wx <= x1; wx++) st.wire[st.idx(wx, y)] |= WIRE_RED;
      for (let wy = y0; wy <= y1; wy++) st.wire[st.idx(tx, wy)] |= WIRE_RED;
      return;
    }
  }
}

/** 雕像(2×3,style*36 步长);STATUES_WITH_TRAPS 命中 → 邻近飞镖陷阱+接线 */
function placeStatue(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, idx: number): boolean {
  const [sheet, style] = STATUE_LIST[idx];
  const tile = sheet === 349 ? STATUE_349 : STATUE_105;
  if (!tile || !st.inBounds(x + 1, y - 2)) return false;
  // Place2xX 前置(cs:39755)：下方双格 SolidTile2（旧缺此门）
  if (!solid2(st, x, y + 1) || !solid2(st, x + 1, y + 1)) return false;
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return false;
    }
  }
  // 雕像帧换行（Place2xX case 105，cs:39716-39720）：每行 55 列——
  // frameX=(style%55)*36、frameY=floor(style/55)*54（与 StatuesPass 同实现；
  // 此前单轴 style*36，style≥55 越界错位）
  const row = Math.floor(style / 55);
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y - 2 + dy, tile, (style - row * 55) * 36 + dx * 18, row * 54 + dy * 18);
    }
  }
  regHouseObj(st, x, y - 2, 2, 3, 'floor');
  if (STATUES_WITH_TRAPS.has(idx)) placeStatueTrap(st, x, y);
  return true;
}

    const rightGap = cur.x + cur.w - (prev.x + prev.w);
    let from: { x: number; y: number };
    if (leftGap > rightGap) from = { x: cur.x + cur.w - 1, y: cur.y + 1 };
    else from = { x: cur.x, y: cur.y + 1 };

/** WorldGen.PlaceTile 派发到各型放置器（FillRooms/cascadePlace 用到的型别全收） */
function placeFurniture(st: TileStore, key: string, x: number, y: number, style = 0, _anchor?: string): boolean {
  const t = TILE_BY_KEY[key];
  if (t === undefined) return false;
  const sheet = TILE_DEFS[t]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
  switch (sheet) {
    case 240: case 440: {           // Place3x3Wall(cs:44281)：(x-1,y-1) 3×3，style>35 行卷绕
      let s = style, row = 0;
      while (s > 35) { row++; s -= 36; }
      return placeWallArt(st, x - 1, y - 1, 3, 3, t, (dx) => s * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => row * 54 + dy * 18);
    }
    case 245:                       // Place2x3Wall(cs:44595)：(x,y-1) 2×3
      return placeWallArt(st, x, y - 1, 2, 3, t, (dx) => style * 36 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
    case 246:                       // Place3x2Wall(cs:44752)：(x-1,y) 3×2
      return placeWallArt(st, x - 1, y, 3, 2, t, (dx) => dx * 18, (dy) => style * 36 + dy * 18);
    case 241:                       // Place4x3Wall(cs:44874)：(x-1,y-1) 4×3
      return placeWallArt(st, x - 1, y - 1, 4, 3, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
    case 242:                       // Place6x4Wall(cs:44959)：(x-2,y-2) 6×4
      return placeWallArt(st, x - 2, y - 2, 6, 4, t, (dx) => (style % 27) * 72 + dx * 18, (dy) => Math.floor(style / 27) * 108 + dy * 18);
    case 34: {                      // PlaceChand(cs:52753)：(x-1,y) 3×3 吊挂；门=九格 !active
      //   + (x,y-1) nactive && tileSolid && !tileSolidTop——【无下方承地门】(吊灯
      //   悬顶),曾误走 placeFloorObject 的 below 检查 → 房内吊灯全灭(room1 实锤)
      if (!st.inBounds(x, y - 1) || !solid2(st, x, y - 1) || HOUSE_SOLID_TOP.has(sheetOf(st, x, y - 1))) return false;
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
        for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
          if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] !== 0) return false;
        }
      }
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
        for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
          st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, t, Math.floor(style / 36) * 108 + (dx + 1) * 18, style * 54 + dy * 18);
        }
      }
      regHouseObj(st, x - 1, y, 3, 3, 'chand');
      return true;
    }
    case 14: case 26: case 86: case 87: case 88: case 89: case 114: case 187: case 215: case 217: case 218:
    case 377: case 469:             // Place3x2(cs:52097)：(x-1,y-1) 3×2，下方逐列 SolidTile2
      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 1, 3, 2, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18);
    case 186:                       // Place3x2 + InvalidTileForPilesOrSpeleothems（拒 Boulders 垫）
      return placeFloorObject(st, x - 1, y - 1, 3, 2, t, (dx) => style * 54 + dx * 18, (dy) => dy * 18, true);
    case 16: case 18: case 29: case 103: case 134: case 462:   // Place2x1(cs:47371)：(x,y) 2×1

  fx: (dx: number) => number, fy: (dy: number) => number, rejectBoulderFloor = false): boolean {
  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
    if (!solid2(st, x0 + dx, y0 + h)) return false;
    if (rejectBoulderFloor && st.inBounds(x0 + dx, y0 + h) && BOULDERS.has(sheetOf(st, x0 + dx, y0 + h))) return false;
  }
  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
      const i = st.idx(x0 + dx, y0 + dy);
      if (!st.inBounds(x0 + dx, y0 + dy) || st.flags[i] !== 0) return false;
    }
  }
  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) st.setTileSilent(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, tile, fx(dx), fy(dy));
  }
  regHouseObj(st, x0, y0, w, h, 'floor');
  return true;
}

	{
		TileFrame(i - 1, j - 1);
		TileFrame(i - 1, j);
		TileFrame(i - 1, j + 1);
		TileFrame(i, j - 1);
		TileFrame(i, j, resetFrame);
		TileFrame(i, j + 1);
		TileFrame(i + 1, j - 1);
		TileFrame(i + 1, j);
		TileFrame(i + 1, j + 1);
	}

	}

export function poundTile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  swAct('P', x, y, 0);
  if (!canPoundTile(st, x, y)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  st.half[i] = st.half[i] ? 0 : 1;
  if (st.half[i]) st.slope[i] = 0;
  return true;
}

export function solidTile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= st.w || y >= st.h) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  // 原版 SolidTile 检查 active()（=flags）：TileRunner 幽灵 tile（有 type 无 flags）
  // 不得当实心——曾致补角分支实体化天空幽灵块成浮空半砖（2583 个）

  if (t === 0) return false;
  const d = TILE_DEFS[t];

}

//   liq = (液量, liquidType) 差。wld 侧 liquidType 实测 {1水,2岩浆,3蜂蜜}（JS LIQUID_TYPE

// 带边界（按 wld 头锚，两世界同尺寸）：
